policy.requiredUnitEntropy: repository tokenFactory, monotonically increasing 128-bit hex fixture tokens
policy.rowOrdering: Each table is ordered ascending by every primary-key column in SQLite PRAGMA table_info pk ordinal order, or every declared column in cid order when no primary key exists. State hashes use recursively sorted JSON object keys and retain array order.
policy.normalization: Replace only the declared temporary data-directory prefix in string values with $DATA. Preserve all IDs, nulls, omissions, enum values, timestamps, hashes, digests, tokens, row counts and array ordering. HTTP ephemeral port and volatile headers are not contract fields and are not captured.
